plain: A scientist named John Blitch, who has worked for DARPA, a US military research agency, says that beings he calls "veterinarians" have taken him off his mountain bike and out of his bed, as if humans were animals being checked by a vet. He links this to a hurricane-like cloud he says formed over his house, which he believes served as cover for them to land. He told this to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025.
